block.guhs.droombed.lore: A starry quilt and a moon for a pillow. Count sheep and stars here.
block.guhs.guh_hoofdbed.lore: The headboard is a big guh. Sleep with your head against a guh and you dream vads.
block.guhs.blub_bed.lore: A real Blub block to sleep in, with stubby legs and ears. It almost squeaks when you get in.
block.guhs.wolkenhemelbed.lore: Sleeping under a cloud, with a little rainbow. No rain ever falls out of it, promise.
block.guhs.guh_blub_mandje.lore: At night a guh and a Blub curl up in it together. Cuddling together is twice as warm.
block.guhs.stapelbedje.lore: For two guhs, top and bottom. Whoever sleeps on top gets the first nibble tomorrow.
block.guhs.luciferdoosje.lore: A little bed for squeaky mice, with a checkered blanket. Squeak... squeak... (that's snoring).
block.guhs.schelpbedje.lore: For Schilly and Poepschilly. Squabbling by day, cuddling in the shell at night.
block.guhs.guh_hoofdbank.lore: A long bench bed with a big guh face as its backrest. Everyone their own nook: guh, Blub, mouse and Schilly.
block.guhs.slaaptreintje.lore: A locomotive with a guh snout and three carriages. Next stop: Dreamland. All aboard, zzz!
block.guhs.kussenfort.lore: Walls of pillows, little flags and a nest for everyone. The only fort where you have to whisper.
block.guhs.droomschuitje.lore: A little boat in the crescent moon, with stars on strings. It rocks you to sleep; nobody gets seasick.
block.guhs.boomhut_stapelbed.lore: Three floors and a birdhouse: the wettest at the bottom, the highest on top, the mouse the cosiest.
block.guhs.quiltbed.lore: A big bed with a patch of quilt for every critter. Whoever rolls over the seam owes a nibble.
block.guhs.badkuipbed.lore: An old bathtub full of foam, with blankets of bubbles. The Schillys keep their corner wet.
block.guhs.knuffelnest.lore: The big round nest for eight guhs, with little ears on its rim. All in a circle, heads towards the nibble bowl.
